Unreal Engine 5 3D game environment render, physically based materials, realistic global illumination, soft volumetric lighting, solid geometry, deep spatial layering, painterly hand painted textures inspired by Disco Elysium. Overhead isometric three quarter 45 degree view of a snow covered industrial neighborhood in northeastern China, winter night. A weathered bus shelter with corrugated metal roof and wooden bench, thick snow piled on top; one elderly woman in a padded dark coat sits at the bench end, hands in lap. Cracked asphalt with footprints, tire tracks, and dark slush. Red brick workers' housing, low factory walls, shuttered shops, and a snow dusted parked utility truck line the street. Rusted drainpipes, overhead wires, peeling metal, rough brick with visible depth and relief. Warm amber streetlamp lights the woman and falling snow; cool blue teal ambient light fills the street. Muted teal and amber palette, worn 1980s socialist era aesthetic, quiet, cold, desolate.
